readout_other: vagus nerve action potentials; hippocampal LFP and c-Fos; macrophage alpha7nAChR immunoreactivity; plasma IL-1beta ELISA; hippocampal proteomics; survival; Nanotag body temperature and locomotor activity; ECG
direction_notes: VNS evoked vagal action potentials and raised hippocampal c-Fos in control mice; in LPS mice it restored alpha7nAChR expression, IL-1beta, 10 Hz hippocampal activity pattern and improved survival when given at 18 h.
safety_notes: ECG and skin/body temperature showed no harmful effects of VNS; heart rate was slower after VNS.

target.label: bilateral cervical vagal nerve (VN) of the mice

timing.protocol_description: Commercial therapy ultrasound applied sequentially to both sides of the neck for 20 min at 3.0 W/cm2 and 50% duty, under deep anaesthesia, at 3 h or 18 h (or 36 h) after LPS.
